findings.title: Webhook body read unbounded after content-length check
findings.attacker: Any caller able to reach the webhook route
findings.controlled_value: request body (chunked transfer with absent/spoofed content-length)
source_trace: receive_tradingview_webhook checked Content-Length header only
chunked requests have no such header; await request.body() then read unbounded data
findings.failed_control: Body size enforced from a spoofable header instead of the stream
findings.proven_result: _read_bounded_body streams at most 64KB and rejects larger bodies before signature verification
findings.conditions: Local/loopback reachability of the webhook route
findings.remediation: Streamed bounded read, independent of headers

findings.title: Reconciliation correction numbers unvalidated (NaN/inf/absurd magnitudes)
findings.attacker: Local API caller submitting a correction
findings.controlled_value: entry_price, exit_price, qty, stop_loss, take_profit, pnl, commission, r_multiple
source_trace: _validate_correction checked only that fields existed
NaN/Infinity/1e300 accepted into stored correction payloads
findings.failed_control: No numeric bounds or finiteness validation
findings.proven_result: _CORRECTION_NUMERIC_BOUNDS + _bounded_correction_number reject non-finite and out-of-range values
findings.conditions: Local API reachability

findings.title: TradeCloseSchema accepted non-finite/absurd exit price and commission
findings.attacker: Local API caller
source_trace: Pydantic schema had no Field constraints
inf/NaN/huge values flowed into trade close records
findings.failed_control: Missing schema bounds
findings.proven_result: Fields now enforce gt/le bounds with allow_inf_nan=False
findings.conditions: Local API reachability

findings.title: Trade list pagination unbounded
findings.attacker: Local API caller
source_trace: list_trades accepted any limit/offset value
findings.failed_control: No pagination bounds
findings.proven_result: limit constrained to 1..1000, offset >= 0
findings.conditions: Local API reachability

findings.title: Integrations gateway mounted the full webhook router (trade confirmation writes)
findings.attacker: Any local process, or a browser page able to reach loopback (CSRF-style POST)
findings.principal_impacted: Trade evidence journal integrity (fabricated confirmed executions)
findings.controlled_value: Confirmation payload (trade data) with no auth dependency
source_trace: gateway.py mounted app.api.webhook_tv:webhook_router
webhook_router includes the manual confirmation endpoint which writes to the ledger
No authentication dependency exists on any route (single-user desktop design)
findings.failed_control: Gateway surface included write routes; no origin/CSRF guard
findings.sink: Evidence ledger write via confirmation handler
findings.proven_result: Gateway now mounts webhook_ingest_router only (/webhook/tradingview); confirm/list routes are no longer reachable there; non-loopback bind additionally refused unless KUANTRA_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK_GATEWAY=1
findings.conditions: Local loopback reachability
findings.remediation: Split routers; mount only ingest on the gateway; loopback-only bind fail-closed

findings.title: Panic kill-switch fabricated closing trades and hardcoded disarm PINs
findings.attacker: Any local API caller; the hardcoded PIN was guessable by anyone
findings.principal_impacted: Forensic evidence integrity (fabricated closes) and lockdown control
source_trace: trigger_emergency_kill_switch wrote synthetic close records for open positions without broker authority
disarm compared against hardcoded PIN hashes present in source
findings.failed_control: No broker confirmation before writing closes; secrets embedded in code
findings.proven_result: Trigger now only locks down and records flattened_positions_count=0 with flattening=DISABLED_NO_ORDER_AUTHORITY; disarm requires KUANTRA_PANIC_DISARM_SECRET (compare_digest) or raises PANIC_DISARM_UNCONFIGURED
findings.conditions: Local API reachability
findings.remediation: Remove fabrication; external secret for disarm; explicit no-order-authority marker

findings.title: Live-execution guard missing on cancel/open-orders and model routes
findings.attacker: Local API caller operating outside PAPER mode
source_trace: dispatch_order enforced paper mode; cancel and open-order routes did not call the guard
model start also accepted mock_mode and custom url
findings.failed_control: Guard implemented on a single route
findings.proven_result: _require_paper_execution_mode now gates dispatch, cancel, and open-order routes (LIVE -> 403 LIVE_EXECUTION_DISABLED, other -> 403 UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTION_MODE); model start rejects custom url and ignores mock_mode
findings.conditions: Local API reachability
findings.remediation: Central execution-mode guard reused by all execution routes

findings.title: Broker import discrepancy amplification copied wholesale into responses
findings.attacker: Caller-controlled import payload size/content
source_trace: reconciliation produced O(rows) discrepancies (probe: 450 for 150 rows)
review summary copied the entire list into the response
findings.failed_control: No output bound on review discrepancies
findings.proven_result: Review copies at most 100 discrepancies and reports discrepancy_count and discrepancies_truncated; probe confirms 450 counted / 100 returned
findings.conditions: Any import scale above the cap
findings.remediation: Slice response list; keep full count

findings.title: Copy broadcast created unverifiable signals when no secret configured
findings.attacker: Local API caller
source_trace: create_master_signal signed with the node private key when no shared secret existed
no peer can verify that signature, so the signal is unusable and misleading
findings.failed_control: Endpoint produced signals that verification always rejects
findings.proven_result: Endpoint returns 503 COPY_SIGNAL_SECRET_UNCONFIGURED unless KUANTRA_COPY_SIGNAL_SECRET is set; with the secret the signal verifies
findings.conditions: Local API reachability
findings.remediation: Fail closed on broadcast without configured secret

findings.title: Workflow actions referenced by mutable tags, including a contents:write release job
findings.entry_point: GitHub Actions on push tag / workflow_dispatch
findings.attacker: Upstream tag move or compromised action publisher
source_trace: all `uses:` entries referenced mutable major tags (@v7, @v2, @v10.1.0)
the publish job holds contents: write and uploads release assets
findings.failed_control: No commit-SHA pinning
findings.proven_result: All actions pinned to full 40-char SHAs resolved from upstream tags; contract test now requires SHA pins
findings.conditions: Requires upstream tag mutation or registry compromise

findings.title: Release checkout persisted credentials into the contents:write job workspace
findings.attacker: Any later step in the publish job (or injected code)
source_trace: actions/checkout defaults to persisting the token in git config
findings.failed_control: persist-credentials not disabled in the highest-privilege job
findings.proven_result: Checkout in the publish job now sets persist-credentials: false
findings.conditions: Requires code execution in a later publish-job step
tests: grep-level verification: release.yml publish job checkout block

findings.title: workflow_dispatch release_tag input used without format validation
findings.attacker: Workflow dispatcher / accidental input
source_trace: RELEASE_TAG fed directly into git/gh-release commands
findings.failed_control: No charset/length validation before shell use
findings.proven_result: Publish job now rejects tags outside ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$ before use
findings.conditions: Requires dispatch permission
tests: grep-level verification: release.yml Validate release tag input step

findings.title: package_linux.sh silently downloaded appimagetool at build time
findings.attacker: Upstream release channel / network attacker
source_trace: missing tool triggered curl of the continuous appimagetool release
no checksum/signature verification before execution
findings.failed_control: Unverified binary fetched and executed
findings.proven_result: Script now fails closed unless APPIMAGETOOL points at an existing executable; no download path remains
findings.conditions: Requires a build environment without the tool
findings.remediation: Explicit verified tool path; fail closed

findings.title: Copy-signal 'signature' accepted by length only
findings.attacker: Any peer/caller that can submit a signal payload
source_trace: execute_copy_signal -> verify_signal(signal)
pre-fix verify_signal compared only len(signature) == 64
verification success -> order_router.route_order(order_payload)
findings.failed_control: No cryptographic verification of the signature value or payload binding
findings.sink: Order routing call on an unauthenticated signal
findings.proven_result: verify_signal now requires KUANTRA_COPY_SIGNAL_SECRET and HMAC-SHA256 compare_digest over a canonical payload; invalid/tampered signals REJECTED; broadcast endpoint returns 503 when no secret is configured
findings.conditions: Reachable from the loopback API
findings.remediation: Shared-secret HMAC over canonical fields; fail closed without secret

findings.title: Non-constant-time secret comparisons in webhook auth
findings.attacker: Local timing observer
findings.principal_impacted: Webhook secrets (HMAC secret, passphrase, tunnel token)
source_trace: verify_hmac_signature / verify_passphrase / tunnel check used == comparisons
early-exit string comparison leaks prefix progress
findings.failed_control: Non-constant-time comparison
findings.proven_result: All three comparisons now use _constant_time_equals(hmac.compare_digest) and tolerate non-ASCII input without crashing
findings.conditions: Timing attack feasibility on loopback is limited

findings.title: Credential probe errors echoed upstream details to callers
findings.attacker: Local API caller
findings.principal_impacted: Exchange credential context (error strings could embed headers/URLs/tokens)
findings.controlled_value: exchange selection; upstream error text originates from provider libraries
source_trace: test_connection exception handler returned str(error)/error type to the caller
upstream messages can contain request URLs, header fragments, account hints
findings.failed_control: Raw upstream error returned in API response
findings.proven_result: _safe_exchange_error_message returns generic per-error-type text; detail is not returned to callers (and not logged with secrets)
findings.conditions: Requires local API reachability plus an upstream failure

findings.title: Dockerfile smoke image lacked pipefail for curl | bash install
findings.attacker: Network/upstream failure mode (availability, not direct compromise)
source_trace: RUN layer piped NodeSource setup script into bash
default /bin/sh has no pipefail, so a failing curl could be masked
findings.failed_control: Shell strictness
findings.proven_result: Dockerfile now sets SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
findings.conditions: Build only

findings.title: Reverse-skill generator interpolated raw strings into executable Python
findings.attacker: Values derived from strategy documents (strategy_id, strategy_name)
source_trace: generator f-string embedded dsl['strategy_id'] and strategy_name into code literals
quotes/newlines in the values could break out of the literal
findings.failed_control: No escaping for generated string literals
findings.sink: Generated .py source compiled by the skill loader
findings.proven_result: _safe_python_string uses json.dumps for both interpolations; generated output stays a literal
findings.conditions: Requires attacker-influenced strategy metadata reaching the generator

findings.title: update_trade interpolated caller-supplied column names into SQL
findings.entry_point: Internal callers (reconciliation, journal edits) reaching SQLiteDriver.update_trade
findings.attacker: Any path where field names derive from parsed/imported or API data
source_trace: update_trade built SET clause from the caller's mapping keys
keys flowed into SQL text without an allowlist
findings.failed_control: No allowlist for updatable columns
findings.proven_result: _UPDATE_TRADE_FIELDS allowlist (snapshot fields minus id, plus updated_at) rejects unknown fields with ValueError
findings.conditions: Requires a caller that passes non-constant keys; defense-in-depth against future call sites

findings.title: Model artifact name used directly under MODELS_DIR
findings.attacker: Any caller of the local API/gateway surface (lower-trust local process or browser page)
source_trace: endpoints.py model routes -> model_downloader.get_status/start_download(model_name)
model_downloader.py:35 pre-fix used MODELS_DIR / model_name without canonicalization
get_status read candidate file metadata; start_download wrote bytes to the derived path
findings.failed_control: No containment check; no separator/absolute rejection
findings.sink: Filesystem read (metadata) and write (artifact bytes) at an attacker-chosen path
findings.proven_result: `../../evil.gguf`, `/etc/hosts`, `..`, `a/b.gguf`, `""` are rejected with ValueError/400 after fix; status no longer exposes arbitrary file metadata
findings.conditions: Reachable from the unauthenticated loopback API; requires local reachability only
findings.remediation: _safe_model_name(): reject empty/None-as-default semantics, separators, absolute paths, >128 chars; resolve and require is_relative_to(MODELS_DIR)

findings.title: Migration archive member extraction trusted declared sizes
findings.attacker: Crafted migration bundle file
findings.controlled_value: zip member contents and declared member size
source_trace: macos_migration.py verify/restore read members via archive.read(name)
declared size could be falsified, bypassing MAX_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_BYTES
unbounded allocation for a single member
findings.failed_control: Size cap only checked declared metadata
findings.proven_result: Reads now stream through _read_member_bounded with hard byte caps (member_bytes, restored_total)
findings.conditions: Requires a migration bundle chosen by the user/attacker
findings.remediation: Streamed bounded reads; reject on exceeding cap
